title: Two Sum
problem: Given an array of integers and a target, return indices of two numbers that add up to the target.
hint: Use a hash map from value to index; one pass, O(n).

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
problem: Find the maximum profit from one buy and one later sell.
hint: Track the minimum price so far and the best profit.

title: Product of Array Except Self
problem: Return an array where each element is the product of all others, without division.
hint: Prefix products from the left, then multiply by suffix products from the right.

title: Maximum Subarray (Kadane)
problem: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum.
hint: Keep a running sum; reset to current element when the sum becomes smaller than it.

title: Valid Anagram
problem: Check whether two strings are anagrams of each other.
hint: Count characters with an array of 26 or a map.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problem: Find the length of the longest substring with all unique characters.
hint: Sliding window with a set or last-seen index map.

title: Group Anagrams
problem: Group a list of words into anagram groups.
hint: Use the sorted word (or a 26-count key) as a map key.

title: Reverse a Linked List
problem: Reverse a singly linked list.
hint: Three pointers: prev, curr, next. Also try recursion.

title: Detect a Cycle
problem: Return true if a linked list has a cycle.
hint: Floyd's slow and fast pointers.

title: Merge K Sorted Lists
problem: Merge k sorted linked lists into one sorted list.
hint: Min-heap of list heads, or divide and conquer merging.

title: Valid Parentheses
problem: Check if a string of brackets is balanced.
hint: Push opening brackets, pop and match on closing ones.

title: Next Greater Element
problem: For each element, find the next element to its right that is larger.
hint: Monotonic decreasing stack.

title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
problem: Return the height of a binary tree.
hint: Recursion: 1 + max(depth(left), depth(right)).

title: Level Order Traversal
problem: Return node values level by level.
hint: BFS with a queue; process one level size at a time.

title: Lowest Common Ancestor in BST
problem: Find the LCA of two nodes in a binary search tree.
hint: Walk from root: go left if both are smaller, right if both are larger, else you found it.

title: Number of Islands
problem: Count islands of '1's in a 2D grid.
hint: DFS or BFS from each unvisited land cell, marking visited.

title: Course Schedule
problem: Can you finish all courses given prerequisite pairs?
hint: Detect a cycle with topological sort (Kahn's algorithm).

title: Word Ladder
problem: Shortest transformation sequence from one word to another, changing one letter at a time.
hint: BFS over words; precompute wildcard patterns like h*t.

title: Climbing Stairs
problem: Count ways to climb n stairs taking 1 or 2 steps at a time.
hint: It's Fibonacci: ways(n) = ways(n-1) + ways(n-2).

title: Coin Change
problem: Minimum coins needed to make an amount.
hint: Bottom-up DP: dp[x] = 1 + min(dp[x - coin]).

title: Longest Common Subsequence
problem: Length of the longest subsequence common to two strings.
hint: 2D DP table; match → diagonal + 1, else max(top, left).

title: Edit Distance
problem: Minimum insert/delete/replace operations to turn one word into another.
hint: 2D DP; each cell takes 1 + min of the three neighbours unless characters match.

title: Second Highest Salary
problem: Write a SQL query to find the second highest salary from an Employee table.
hint: Use DISTINCT with ORDER BY ... LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1, or MAX with a subquery.

title: Department Top Earners
problem: Find the employee(s) with the highest salary in each department.
hint: Window function: RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY salary DESC).
